Meta.title: Besteron POS
Meta.description: A modern point of sale for your business.

hero.title: The whole checkout.
hero.imageAlt: Besteron payment terminal showing the home screen

features.title: Card and cash
features.text: The terminal sits right at the checkout.

features.title: eKasa included
features.text: Legally compliant receipts, no extra box.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Keep selling, the data syncs on its own.

closerLook.title: Take a closer look
closerLook.photoAlt: A customer paying by phone at a café counter

tap.label: Tap, tap, paid
tap.title: Tap, tap, paid.
tap.text: Colour-coded categories and search. Find any item with one tap, no scrolling.

split.label: Paying separately?
split.title: Paying separately?
split.text: No problem. Split the table's bill with one tap – or pay it all at once.

payments.label: Any payment
payments.title: Any payment.
payments.text: Card, cash, meal vouchers – even combined on a single bill.

receipts.label: Compliant receipts
receipts.title: Compliant receipts.
receipts.text: eKasa is built right into the POS. No need to worry about fiscalisation.

offline.label: Internet down?
offline.title: Internet down?
offline.text: Keep selling. The POS syncs everything once it's back online.

secondDisplay.label: Second display
secondDisplay.title: The customer sees the total. You see everything else.
secondDisplay.text: The top display shows the amount due. No turning the device around, no misunderstandings.

waiter.label: Ordering at the table
waiter.title: Ordering at the table.
waiter.text: With the Mobile Waiter module you take the order and the payment right at the guest's table.
